aboutMe.subtitle: Hello!
aboutMe.content: Nice to meet you!, I am Fabian Stiven Valencia Cordoba

aboutMe.subtitle: Profession
aboutMe.content: I am a Systems Engineer, Professor, Researcher, 3D Modeler, UX/UI Designer, Video Game Developer, Metaverses, Extended Reality and 3D Web

aboutMe.subtitle: Passion
aboutMe.content: I am passionate about developing immersive applications

aboutMe.subtitle: Education
aboutMe.content: I have a degree in Systems Engineering at Universidad del Valle (CO), with mention of laureate thesis

aboutMe.subtitle: Education
aboutMe.content: I have a degree in Information Systems Technology at Universidad del Valle (CO) Sede Yumbo

aboutMe.subtitle: Experience
aboutMe.content: I am currently a Researcher at Universidad del Valle (CO) in the Camaleón Research Group, focusing on Extended Reality (AR, MR, VR), Web 3D, 3D Modeling, UX/UI, and Metaverses

aboutMe.subtitle: Experience
aboutMe.content: I was professor at Universidad del Valle (CO) in the 2024-1 semester, teaching courses such as Integrative Project I, Video Game Development, Fundamentals of Event-Driven Programming, and Web Applications and Wireless Networks

aboutMe.subtitle: Experience
aboutMe.content: I was a Service Technician at Universidad del Valle (CO) to provide technical support for the specialized training diploma 'Specialized training, good practices in the use of Science, Technology, and Innovation and Technological Transfer'

aboutMe.subtitle: Experience
aboutMe.content: I was a Support Professional in the PMO coordination of the project 'Strengthening business competitiveness through the use of STI as a cross-cutting development tool in the Valle del Cauca department'
